metadata.hypothesis_title: Thalamic Morphology Modulates Thalamocortical Coupling via Structural Connectivity in Insomnia

critic_findings.message: Missing DTI, EEG, and MRI data limit the full scope of the hypothesis. Only fMRI proxies are available.
critic_findings.recommendation: Consider integrating multi-modal data if available, or clarify the limitations in the interpretation.

critic_findings.message: Missing data in predictors and outcomes (24.73%) may affect model convergence and power.
critic_findings.recommendation: Implement imputation techniques or use models robust to missing data.
